facts.what: 坐在案发公寓对面湿墙上，伪装观察，看完全程
facts.anchor: she remains seated on the damp wall across the street from the flat where Cassie Torrance and Blair Cameron committed murder

facts.what: 日记是她自己藏进浴室的，盼有人找到
facts.anchor: she’d wondered if she’d be the one to find her journal that she’d stashed in the bathroom

facts.what: 研究 Blair、盼她更快识破 George 并反抗
facts.anchor: she had a gut instinct that Blair would be able to look after herself

facts.what: Cassie 本不该被卷进计划；她自责
facts.anchor: Cassie was never supposed to be part of this plan.

facts.what: 她与 Cassie 有旧谊：知她不弱、爱她的大心脏；当年二选一她选错
facts.anchor: It was him or her, and sadly she chose wrongly.

facts.what: 看见 George 的车载走卷起的地毯，确认谋杀发生
facts.anchor: the rolled-up rug being carried to the boot of George’s car

facts.what: 对猫说「你好 Luna，Cassie 没事，你替我看着她」
她活着，等有勇气向 Cassie 坦白，就不再是 unknown
facts.anchor: when she finally finds the courage to come clean to Cassie, she will no longer be unknown

relations: Louise 是 Cassie 失联好友、日记作者、Luna 原主人（Phoenix）；George 前女友
